debug.xml points web.path to ./traccar-web/simple, and the server stops at startup when that folder is missing (the submodule is empty in this checkout). make dev works around it with an API-only run (CONFIG_USE_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES=true, WEB_PATH=./target/web). The web UI cannot be served locally until the submodule question is answered.

This machine has only JDK 17 (default) and Homebrew JDK 25. The gates were verified on JDK 25 through tools/harness/java-home.sh. CI uses Temurin 21. Every Gradle run also needs Maven Central, because build.gradle resolves versions at configuration time.

open_questions.question: How is the managed hosting (traccar.org pricing) and the demo server deployed and updated: from the Docker images, installers, or another pipeline outside this repository?
Who is allowed to run the 'Build Release' workflow, and how is a bad release rolled back (re-tag, previous Docker tag, schema rollback)?
For the managed service, where are logs, metrics and alerts kept, and which signal tells you production is broken (only /api/health, or something else)?
Should outside contributors and agents always open a pull request, while maintainers keep committing directly to master as the history shows?
What is the definition of done for a protocol change: is a decoder test with a real device sample always required, and must tools/test-integration.py also pass?
Which Java version should developers use: 21 (CI and build.gradle) or 25 (release builds and Docker images)? .java-version says 21 for now.
Should local development check out the traccar-web submodule (relative URL ../traccar-web.git), or is the backend usually run without the web UI?

task.title: Add unit tests for HealthResource
task.description: GET /api/health (src/main/java/org/traccar/api/resource/HealthResource.java) is what systemd and the Docker healthchecks use to restart Traccar, but it has no test. Add HealthResourceTest covering the database check and the web.healthCheck.dropThreshold message-ratio logic, using Mockito for Config, StatisticsManager and Storage.
acceptance: src/test/java/org/traccar/api/resource/HealthResourceTest.java exists and runs with make test TESTS=org.traccar.api.resource.HealthResourceTest
Tests cover: 200 OK when storage answers, 500 when storage throws StorageException, 500 when stored messages drop below the configured threshold, 200 when no threshold is set
No change to HealthResource.java, or a minimal change justified in the PR description

harness_gaps.problem: Conventions mention only 'single-class imports'. The import order that Checkstyle enforces (third-party org.*, then java/javax/jakarta, then static, alphabetical, with one blank line between groups) is not documented, so my first check-fast failed with 10 CustomImportOrder errors. Note that main code puts jakarta after org.* with a blank line, which is easy to copy wrongly into a test.

Layout says tests mirror main packages and points to BaseTest, but there is no src/test/java/org/traccar/api package and no example of testing a Jersey resource. A short note on how to unit-test a resource (private @Inject fields, no mockito-junit-jupiter, BaseResource.storage hidden by subclass fields) would save searching.
make check-fast output on Checkstyle failure prints only 'violations by severity: [error:10]'; the skill could say the details are in build/reports/checkstyle/test.xml (or main.xml).

unmet: src/test/java/org/traccar/api/resource/HealthResourceTest.java exists and runs with make test TESTS=org.traccar.api.resource.HealthResourceTest
